game.title: Rayman Legends
game.blurb: 2D platformer from Ubisoft Montpellier (RAWG also lists Ubisoft), published by Ubisoft Entertainment, released 2013-08-29. RAWG average playtime: 5 hours. Genre: Platformer. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: Paintings, Worlds and Princesses
chapters.summary: Finishing the named paintings and worlds, freeing Barbara and the other princesses, and the five Dark Teensies.

chapters.title: Teensies, Lums and the Collection
chapters.summary: Rescuing Teensies, lucky tickets, the Heroes Gallery, creatures, painting locks and the Invasion paintings.

chapters.title: Cups
chapters.summary: Lums and Teensy cups, and every Bronze, Silver, Gold and Diamond Cup.

chapters.title: Level Feats and Kung Foot
chapters.summary: Special feats in named levels such as "Lucha Libre Get Away", "The Mysterious Inflatable Island" and "Mansion of the Deep", plus a Kung Foot win.

chapters.title: Moves and Tricks
chapters.summary: Turnips, flying punches, parachutes, shields, axe slides, Toads and Rubber Ducks.

attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 242550)
StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Rayman_Legends
Fandom (ubisoft.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://ubisoft.fandom.com/wiki/Rayman_Legends
notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's first result is the expected entry (id 3771). Steam app 242550 ("Rayman® Legends") was used; the store list also has "Rayman Legends Retold" (4084710), which was not used. None of the 42 Steam achievements is hidden. StrategyWiki has a page at completion stage 0 (marked as a stub) that links about 101 subpages, mostly level names such as "Castle Rock" and "Dragon Slayer", but only its Controls and Table of Contents subpages exist, so nothing was used and the level order is not known. rayman.fandom.com, rayman-official.fandom.com and raymanwiki.fandom.com return 404 and raymanlegends.fandom.com was also tried; ubisoft.fandom.com answers under "Rayman Legends" but the page has no linked articles. Names only were looked at, nothing copied. The world and level names in the chapters come from the achievement descriptions. "Rubber Ducks" and "Watch out!" (Toads) name level enemies but no level, so they sit in moves and tricks.
